transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I'm really only here because my family and our accountant insisted on a medical evaluation, but I think it's unnecessary. I’m absolutely certain I’m seeing things more clearly than everyone else and that my ideas can’t be wrong, even when my family says they make no sense.
Have you noticed any hallucinations, such as hearing voices or seeing things that other people do not?

Yes, when I'm out in the fields or lying in bed at night, I hear a man's voice as clear as if he's standing right next to me. He tells me which rows to plant and warns me that my family is trying to sabotage my project, even though when I turn around there's nobody there.
Do you believe the voice is coming from an outside source, like a real person nearby, or do you think it may be coming from your own mind?

It definitely sounds like it's coming from an outside source, as if a real man is standing right next to me talking out loud. It's not a thought in my own head at all, even though when I turn around to look, there's nobody there.
How long have you been hearing this voice and holding these beliefs, and has it been present most days for at least a month?

Yes, it has been going on for way longer than a month. I've been hearing that voice and holding onto these beliefs almost every single day for about a year now, starting shortly after I began the farm's tech expansion.
Has anyone close to you, especially a family member or someone you spend a lot of time with, ever started believing the same unusual ideas as you or seemed to share them?

No, absolutely not—in fact, it's the exact opposite. My wife, kids, and our accountant think my plans make no sense and keep telling me they're completely impossible. They don't believe a word I say and are just trying to hold me back and stop me.
Has anyone close to you ever started believing these same ideas after spending time with you, or are you the only one who holds these beliefs?

No, I am definitely the only one who holds these beliefs. My family, our accountant, and even the banker all tell me that my ideas make no sense and are completely impossible. I know I'm the only one who can see the truth clearly, but they're all just too small-minded to understand the breakthrough I'm making.
Have you ever had a close family member or someone you spend a lot of time with start believing these same ideas, or are you the only one who holds them?

No, like I said, I am completely on my own with this. My family and the accountant think my ideas make no sense, and I'm convinced they are actually trying to sabotage my plans because they are too small-minded. I am the only one who truly understands the breakthrough I'm making.
Besides the voice and these beliefs, have you had any other symptoms like disorganized speech or behavior, or trouble with motivation, emotions, or functioning at work and home?

When I try to explain my plans, my words jump all over the place from soil microbes to satellites until I forget the original question, and sometimes I just stand staring at the sky or pacing by the barn for hours. Because of that, bills and chores have piled up, fields went unworked, and my family actually had to step in to block a major equipment loan because they thought I was going to bankrupt us.
Have you had a clear decline in your work, self-care, or daily functioning because of these symptoms, such as trouble keeping up with chores, finances, or conversations?

Yes, there's definitely been a major decline in how things are running on the farm. I've let basic chores pile up, fields have gone completely unworked, and bills have gone unpaid while I've been focused on my plans. It got so bad that my family had to step in and stop me from signing a major equipment loan because they were terrified I would bankrupt us.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient has a year-long psychotic illness with prominent persecutory and grandiose delusions, clear auditory hallucinations perceived as external, disorganized speech/behavior, and marked functional decline in work and daily responsibilities. Duration and symptom pattern are most consistent with paranoid schizophrenia.
